recent_excerpts: ShinyHunters defaced fbijobs.gov and gave the FBI one week to retract a May PSA, claiming 2-3 TB stolen via a PeopleSoft flaw tracked as CVE-2026-35273.
ShinyHunters breached the Florida DMV after a Plant City officer's login sat on a personal device. The state confirmed the claim on September 10 after days of silence.
Instructure paid ShinyHunters after two Canvas intrusions stole data from 9,000 institutions. Congress launched an investigation into the ed-tech vendor's incident response.
